ValidationRule.description: A Patient Device belongs to one patient, so its Account must be a Person Account. Checked only when the device is created or its Account or record type changes, so existing devices keep reporting status while they are fixed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Patient_Device", NOT(ISBLANK(AccountId)), NOT(Account.IsPersonAccount), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Patient Device belongs to a patient: choose a Person Account. A board that belongs to a ward or a business account uses the Internal Device record type.
